description: Use this when you sell to agents (an x402 seller, a marketplace, an API) and want to know who is on the other side before you serve or after a payment arrives: give wallet, the 0x address that is paying you. Returns whether a Base ERC-8004 registration is bound to it (any bound wallet), how many, the highest-level one in short (level, last payment, whether its Agent Pass holds and until when, the Watch reading of its newest payment, open incidents, detections in 30 days), what the address itself is in our feed (plain key, contract or EIP-7702 delegate, frozen by an issuer, planted as a poisoning look-alike), and the items worth a look, each with its source. A wallet with no registration is reported as such: that is not a statement about it. Facts, never a verdict; you decide whom to serve.
